name: domain.hermes_state_fts5
description: Hermes SQLite WAL state storage with FTS5 search, parent-child session compression splitting, and cross-session recall

entrypoints.name: fts5_search_messages
entrypoints.description: Execute fast full-text search across historical conversation trajectories

entrypoints.name: fork_session_tree
entrypoints.description: Fork session history into a child branch with parent_session_id compression linkage

entrypoints.name: compress_session_slice
entrypoints.description: Apply AST/textual compression to a window of messages to bound token context

parameters.name: window_size
parameters.description: Number of recent turns to retain uncompressed

entrypoints.name: query_session_provenance
entrypoints.description: Retrieve full lineage and parent DAG coordinates for a given message or checkpoint
